name: LLNL SAGE (Science Accelerating Growth and Engagement) Summer Camp
org: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) Science Education Program
what_you_do: A free one week summer day camp at Lawrence Livermore Lab. Lab scientists lead hands-on science and tech projects and talk about their jobs.
who_can_apply: Current 9th to 11th graders at a Northern California public high school, ages 14 to 17 and under 18 at camp time. A GPA above 3.5 is preferred.
duration: One week. The 2026 camp was June 8 to 12.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened Jan 19, 2026, student deadline Feb 26, 2026 (11:59 p.m.), recommendation letter due March 6, 2026, decisions mid-April. 2027 dates are not posted yet. Expect a January opening again.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Ask a teacher, coach or other adult who knows you to write you a letter. In 2026 there was an online info talk in February.
notes: Competitive. Public school students only. The page said 'Not accepting applications' on Oct 16, 2026. Contact: stem-education@llnl.gov. The Livermore library list mentions proof of COVID vaccination, but the LLNL page does not, so that may be out of date.
